title: Finite pushforwards kill higher cohomology and preserve coherence: for f : X -> Y finite with Y locally Noetherian and F quasi-coherent, R^pf_*F = 0 for p > 0, and f_*F is coherent whenever F is.
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter coherent.tex (Cohomology of Schemes)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28), file coherent.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Both assertions are argued in the span: higher direct images vanish because finite morphisms are affine by definition and affine morphisms have no higher direct images (lemma-relative-affine-vanishing); coherence reduces to algebra over an affine V = Spec(A): the finite presentation gives f^{-1}(V) = Spec(B) with B finite over A, the sheaf-module dictionary (lemma-coherent-Noetherian, card L16368) translates the claim into the statement that a finite B-module is finite over A, which is the Algebra chapter's finite-over-finite lemma; the Noetherianity remark (X locally Noetherian since f has finite type) legitimizes the terminology.
